title: Munāẓara-yi Bazm u Razm ('The Debate of Fight and Feast')

date.basis: MK: 'completed before' 25 Rabīʿ II 829/6 March 1426, asterisked as probably a date of transcription; the Majlis 10196 copy (ff. 162b-65a) is dated five days earlier, 20 Rabīʿ II 829/1 March 1426, and both dates come from Āqā Buzurg (al-Dharīʿa, 22/293, no. 7152).

addressee: Bāysunghur (Ritter and Reinert, as cited by MK)
manuscript: 8 items listed; earliest dated: MS Majlis 10196 ff. 162b-65a (20 Rabīʿ II 829/1 March 1426); then MS 5423 (842/1439), MS 1825 (851/1447), MS 10004 (903-4/1497-98), and later copies.
summary: An ornate mystical debate between the sword and the pen, in which Sulṭān ʿIshq judges between the warlike court of Majesty and the banqueting hall of Beauty.
